newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy targets group profit of 60 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy targets group profit of 60 bln yen.

text.p: Japan Energy Corp said on Wednesday it aims to triple its group current profit to 60 billion yen in three years time.

The firm said that by 2000/01, it will aim for profits of 30 billion yen from oil business, 15 billion yen from metals business, nine billion yen from electronic materials business and six billion yen from other areas.
Japan Energy specialises in mining development and petroleum refining.
Its group companies include Nippon Mining and Metals Co Ltd, which is due to be listed on the stock market by the end of 1998/99.

For the fiscal year which ended on March 31, Japan Energy forecast a net loss of 16 billion yen in its group earnings, compared with a net profit of 20.70 billion yen in the previous year. It forecast a group current profit of 19 billion yen for 1996/97, against 21.50 billion yen a year earlier.
